Term1: Enterococcal infections in bone or joint prostheses
Text:
# ENTEROCOCCAL INFECTIONS IN BONE OR JOINT PROSTHESES

For acute, moderate or severe infections, treat with intravenous antibiotics followed by oral antibiotics. For severe infections, add an aminoglycoside for synergy during the first weeks of therapy. Mild infections can be treated with oral antibiotics only.

Consult Infectious Diseases for specific management advice.

# Duration of Treatement

Treat for a total duration of 4-6 weeks. Chronic oral antimicrobial suppression may follow treatment based on individual patient circumstances.
